ModMetaData.name: RimWorld Together (KMH)
ModMetaData.author: Nova and Company, KMH edition
ModMetaData.description:
RimWorld Together (KMH) — a fork of RimWorld Together with extensive QoL, economy, and Discord-integration additions on top of the Official multiplayer baseline.
What KMH adds on top of vanilla RimWorld Together: - Guild system with treasury, ranks, members, hall, and leaderboards - Marketplace: post items for sale, browse, buy, list WTBs, treasury sourcing - Quest board: post quests, accept, complete for rewards - Live leaderboards: per-player and per-guild, sortable, with badges and own-row highlighting - Discord bridge: link your account, !market / !buy / !sell / !showcase / !wtb commands, live leaderboard embeds, chat relay - Custom-built sites with worker progression, skill XP, and KMH-only site types - One-click local-host: bundled per-platform server, install + edit configs + launch from the main menu - Stronger anti-cheat: wealth clamping, packet validation, per-player cooldowns, IP banning
Drop-in replacement for the Official "RimWorld Together" mod. Servers built with KMH speak a superset of the Official protocol — KMH clients cannot connect to vanilla RWT servers and vice versa.
For self-hosters: bundled server builds for Windows / Linux x64 / macOS Intel / macOS Apple Silicon ship inside the mod itself; click Host Local Server in the main menu, KMH copies the right binary into AppData, and one click later you're running.
